task_title: [P2] 8 of 16 'spec' subcommands undocumented (spec-to-build loop invisible in VERBS.md/SPEC-CORPUS.md) and no <task> example in the authored corpus
task_criteria: 1) docs/VERBS.md '## spec' section documents all 16 subcommands incl. the 8 loop verbs with their digest/refusal semantics; 2) docs/SPEC-CORPUS.md gains a 'spec-to-build loop' section with one worked example corpus containing a <task plan=...> block; 3) specs/ (authored corpus) or docs carries a runnable <task> example; 4) 'spec align --help' no longer references a positional ROOT; 5) plan-approve records a non-empty timestamp by default (or documents the empty-at behaviour and its rationale).

items.criterion: 1) docs/VERBS.md '## spec' section documents all 16 subcommands incl. the 8 loop verbs with their digest/refusal semantics
items.detail: docs/VERBS.md:598 '## spec'; each of the 16 subcommands has a bullet (grep '`auger spec <sub>' = 1 hit each for validate/check/bundle/align/list/assemble/render/context + the 8 loop verbs task-packet:717, plan-draft:722, plan-approve:730, plan-export:740, task-export:750, plan-reconcile:752, judge-packet:757, judge-handoff:764). Loop block ':709 The spec-to-build loop (AUG-119/AUG-121/AUG-124): the other eight subcommands, one digest chain.' states the digest chain (:713 'Every hand is bound to a digest — the sha256 of the canonical artifact') and the blanket refusal semantics (:716 'typed `spec error (<code>)` on stderr, exit 2, nothing written'); per-verb typed codes named: stale-plan-digest:733, invalid-plan-digest:734, missing-approver:734, approval-ledger-unwritable:738, approval-ledger-unverified:739, unknown-task:724, dispatch-unconfigured:772. AST census of auger.py add_parser constants returned exactly the 16 spec subcommands in doc order.

items.criterion: 2) docs/SPEC-CORPUS.md gains a 'spec-to-build loop' section with one worked example corpus containing a <task plan=...> block
items.detail: docs/SPEC-CORPUS.md:115 '## The spec-to-build loop, on a runnable example (AUG-206)'; the fenced xml corpus (SPEC-CORPUS.md:175-180) contains `<task id="EXAMPLE-TASK-1" ... plan="EXAMPLE-PLAN" plan-version="1.0.0" in-scope="EXAMPLE-REQ-1" acceptance="EXAMPLE-AC-1" out-of-scope="EXAMPLE-REQ-9">`; fence verified byte-identical to docs/spec-example/tracker-loop.xml (python fence==file True; `python3 scripts/check_spec_example.py` → rc=0 'PASS: SPEC-CORPUS.md example fence == docs/spec-example/tracker-loop.xml (2869 bytes)'); the doc then walks the chain command-by-command with expected output (SPEC-CORPUS.md:188-225) and its fail-closed refusals (:236-239).

items.criterion: 3) specs/ (authored corpus) or docs carries a runnable <task> example
items.detail: docs/spec-example/tracker-loop.xml ships the runnable <task plan=...> example: `.venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate docs/spec-example` → 'spec: 1 document(s), 5 block(s), 5 reference(s) ok' rc=0; `spec check` → status valid rc=0; `spec task-packet docs/spec-example --task EXAMPLE-TASK-1` rc=0 (digest 877d69ee…); `spec plan-draft --plan EXAMPLE-PLAN` rc=0 (digest 07828ee7…); `spec plan-approve` rc=0 recorded the ledger line in a /tmp scratch copy. (specs/ itself has no <task> block; docs carries it, which is what AC3 allows.)

items.criterion: 4) 'spec align --help' no longer references a positional ROOT
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python auger.py spec align --help` usage line is 'usage: auger spec align [-h] [--repo-root DIR] [--spec-root DIR] [--protocol-version PROTOCOL_VERSION] [--diff-stdin] [--diff-file PATH] [--max-diff-bytes N] [--semantic]' — no positional; the --spec-root help now reads 'default: <repo-root>/specs (on `spec check`, this flag overrides the positional ROOT; `spec align` takes no positional ROOT)'. Source: the shared flag helper diff at auger.py:13225-13228 in commit 8059814 (old string 'default: the positional ROOT, else <repo-root>/specs' removed). VERBS.md:621 align entry likewise shows no ROOT.

items.criterion: 5) plan-approve records a non-empty timestamp by default (or documents the empty-at behaviour and its rationale)
items.detail: auger.py:11457 `at=a.at or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()` in cmd_spec_plan_approve (the sole caller of record_plan_approval, auger.py:10452). Live: in /tmp/aug206-check, plan-approve with `--at ""` stored at=2026-11-23T20:19:55.618074+00:00; without --at stored at=2026-11-23T20:19:58.551341+00:00; both ledger lines non-empty. Regression test tests/test_plan_approval.py:1149 test_plan_approve_records_a_nonempty_iso_timestamp_by_default asserts non-empty tz-aware `at` plus ledger read-back — AUGER_CI=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_plan_approval.py → '12 passed in 4.76s'. Documented at VERBS.md:734-735 ('without it the current UTC time (ISO 8601) is recorded — the ledger never carries an empty timestamp (AUG-206)') and in the --at help string (auger.py:14693).

items.criterion: The documented loop is actually reachable and behaves as the docs say — a reader can execute the SPEC-CORPUS.md example end-to-end
items.detail: Executed on a copy of the shipped example (/tmp/aug206-check): task-packet → plan-draft → plan-approve rc=0 (ledger written) → plan-export invoked boardctl (`stub boardctl: -C /tmp/aug206-board show EXAMPLE-TASK-1` in the calls log; export status 'partial' rc=1 with the stub returning no row payload — proving the approval gate passed and boardctl was reached). Typed refusals match the docs verbatim: 'spec error (unknown-task): NOPE is not a task block in this corpus (a task packet is built from a <task> block, never from a board row's prose)' rc=2; 'spec error (stale-plan-digest): EXAMPLE-PLAN: approved digest 000…0 does not match the current plan 07828ee7… — approve the plan you are actually looking at' rc=2 — both word-for-word the documented texts (VERBS.md:733, SPEC-CORPUS.md:236).

items.criterion: No regression: the code touch (auger.py +8/-3), the new example and the corpora rebind must keep the doc contract and the spec battery green
items.detail: AUGER_CI=1 hermetic spec battery: tests/test_plan_approval.py+test_task_packet.py+test_xml_specs.py → '80 passed in 17.12s'; test_usage_skill.py+test_spec_validators_agree.py → '31 passed in 18.11s'; test_xsd_conformance.py+test_spec_repository_root.py → '21 passed in 9.55s'; test_spec_context.py+test_task_context.py → '12 passed in 0.65s'; tests/test_spec_ingest.py (covers the follow-up corpora rebind c529571) → '19 passed in 15.62s'. `bash tests/docs_check.sh` → exit 0 'PASS: README claims match code … loop verbs ok (17 listed, 18 shipped), VERBS.md registry ok'. ruff: `git show 8059814^:auger.py` → 37 findings vs current auger.py → 37 findings — the commit adds zero net lint findings (the new UP017 mirrors 36 pre-existing ones). Full `bash tests/gate.sh` cannot run green in this environment (needs a live DuckBrain URL — the same env failure recorded in tier1), so the battery above is the regression evidence.
